correctness.rationale: Reconstructed S=Cayley(Z4²,{±(1,0),±(0,1),±(1,1)}), its 48 edges and induced matching endpoint criterion. Independent enumerator checked all 17296 edge triples: 32 passing, and all 194580 quadruples: 0 passing; each original edge belongs to exactly 2 maximum matchings, and no pair of maxima shares 2 edges, yielding R1=32 isolates, R2=48 edges, cubic. Two 16-element translation orbits of maxima map to the two 16-element orbits of triangles via L(x,y)=(2x+3y,x+y) mod4; voltage sets {00,13,21} map to {00,30,33}, verifying all adjacencies. BFS from each of 32 states finds eccentricity5 and shortest cycle6. Checked actual verify_equivariant.py and independent reconstruction; all claims finite and exhaustible.
